This video is considered a core element of the [[Video path]], however it predates it and as such does not have a proper segue in it like other videos. The reason it is considered core is that a lot of older videos end up connecting into the video path through this video, and [[Can No Nut November give you enlightenment?]] links to it due to being so thematically appropriate it is considered good even if it doesn't go through the video path in the right way.

== Segue ==
Right now it just links to [[A Systems-Oriented Theory of Everything]] but in the future it might be moved to connect to another video. I imagine [[How I stopped being an incel]]
